entities.name: Squee
entities.description: A formerly immortal goblin of Dominaria, cabin-hand on the Weatherlight and for a time king of a goblin clan.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: A skyship on which Squee served.

entities.name: Sisay
entities.description: Captain saved by Squee from his tribe.

entities.name: Hanna
entities.description: Crew member pressured to fix the Weatherlight.

entities.name: Salvation Sphere
entities.description: Protected the purity of Squee's soul.

entities.name: Ertai
entities.description: Killed accidentally by Squee; later compleated Squee.

entities.name: Slimefoot
entities.description: Fought alongside Squee in defense of Dominaria.

entities.name: Mercadia
entities.description: Plane where Squee became an elite.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion during which Squee was captured.

events.summary: Aged ten, Squee saves Captain Sisay from his tribe, is exiled, and joins the Weatherlight crew as cabin boy.
events.quote: Squee saved Captain Sisay from his tribe and was exiled in response

events.summary: Volrath tortures Squee to force Hanna to fix the Weatherlight; allies intervene.
events.quote: Squee was tortured by Volrath to ensure compliance from Hanna

events.summary: Yawgmoth grants Squee immortality so Ertai and Crovax can kill him repeatedly; Squee accidentally kills Ertai.
Squee becomes king of a goblin clan by winning a trial by combat.
events.quote: Squee became the king of a goblin clan

events.summary: Ertai captures and compleats Squee, but his body blows up the mountain and destroys the Phyrexian cell.
events.quote: Squee was captured by Ertai and fully Compleated

events.summary: Squee chooses to be revived once more, becoming a mortal goblin again.
Squee fights alongside Slimefoot in the New Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: Squee fought alongside Slimefoot in defense of Dominaria

relations.quote: leading him to request to join the Weatherlight' s crew as a cabin boy
